task.title: WKWebView: printings-row overlay links cover the whole card page
task.description:
Maintainer report (2026-08-16, rebuilt desktop .app): the card-detail Back button 'seems nonfunctional'. Orchestrator live-probed the real .app (pid-exact a11y tools): the Back link WORKS via a11y AXPress, but a COORDINATE click at its exact location stays on the card page — because every printings-table stretched row link (#158: TableRow class='relative' + <a class='absolute inset-0'> in the first cell) reports an a11y frame of the FULL CONTENT AREA (1680x1018 at a 1700x1050 window). Mechanism: WebKit does not honor position:relative on <tr> (CSS 2.1 leaves position on table rows UA-defined; Blink honors it, WebKit doesn't), so the stretched links' containing block falls to the nearest positioned ancestor — the page container — and N invisible full-page overlays stack over ALL card-detail controls. Every mouse interaction on the page (Back, steppers, wants, hero) hits the topmost row link, which same-page-replaces to ?printing=... — visually a no-op, reading as 'button does nothing'. Android/Chromium unaffected (honors tr-relative); a11y/keyboard unaffected (AXPress bypasses hit-testing) — which is how it slipped past both e2e (chromium) and the a11y-driven .app verification.

Fix: give the stretched link a containing block every engine honors — candidates: position:relative on the first CELL with the link stretched to the row via explicit sizing; restructuring the row-link pattern (visible link + CSS grid rows instead of table semantics); transform/clip-path tricks on tr are ALSO unreliable in WebKit, don't trade one UA-defined behavior for another. Whatever ships must keep: whole-row clickability in chromium, keyboard/a11y focus order, the #166 hover-anchor geometry (the trigger content span), and the printings tests green.

Verification REQUIRED in the real .app via the committed pid-exact tools (end2end/wkwebview/axdrive.swift): coordinate-click (not AXPress) the Back link on a card page → lands on the source page; coordinate-click a printings row → navigates to that ?printing=; coordinate-click a have/want stepper on the card page → increments. Plus chromium card-detail.spec.ts serial green. Probe screenshots: /tmp/tr-b1.png (card page), /tmp/tr-b3.png (click ate by overlay).
